description: This file defines the MessagePackCodec class, which provides serialization and copying functionalities based on MessagePack for types in an Orleans serialization framework. It handles encoding and decoding of objects, supporting type filtering and reflection attributes, and implements several Orleans serialization interfaces.

classes.name: MessagePackCodec
classes.description: A serialization codec which uses MessagePackSerializer to serialize and deserialize objects within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: MessagePackCodec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the codec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a field using MessagePack serialization.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a value from the data stream.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using MessagePack serialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a type is allowed based on supported types filters.
